spec_match.rationale: Exercises §10.1's unclamped out-of-range contract with the spec's own §13 worked example (0.0871 0.8205 -0.0146 and its clip) as presets, and explains the 12-vs-10-bit precision requirement from the serialization table.

interactive.rationale: Sliders range -0.5..1.5 with out-of-range values flagged in the value labels and gamut chips; the apply-and-read-back button runs a real parse + getComputedStyle round-trip per space; presets re-run the probe automatically. CDP verified the overbright preset updated flags, table and verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises pushing components past 0 and 1 and reading back what the browser stores, with the linear space's precision story — delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: This IS the edge-case concept: negative and >1 components, the clipped twin preset, the unsupported dropped-declaration row, and a shipped-space control demonstrating the identical contract for real.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, §10.5 and the gamut-mapping section linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's out-of-range-components-preserved script assertion pins exactly this page's contract (1.5 and -0.2 surviving the round trip) and fails cleanly where the space is absent.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP on Chromium 141: the display-p3 control row genuinely demonstrated the contract — color(display-p3 0.0871 0.8205 -0.0146) and color(display-p3 1.5 0.2 0.2) both parsed and round-tripped unclamped — while the display-p3-linear row honestly reported the dropped declaration; zero console errors. NOT verified: the linear space's own row, which needs Chrome 144+.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for the supported round-trip, the explicit unsupported branch, and the shipped-space preservation control — each able to fail.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; out-of-range value labels and gamut chips use rose/emerald on light backgrounds (AA); table ok/bad cells are bold accents on paper.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled sliders, aria-live gamut flags and declaration/verdict outputs, semantic table with caption and scoped headers, native buttons at 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: zero horizontal overflow; the four-column round-trip table scrolls in its own container; slider grid shrinks via minmax(0,1fr).

openQuestions.title: Verify the linear row's unclamped round-trip on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: On this build the unclamped contract was proven in the shipped display-p3 space only. A 144+ pass should show the display-p3-linear row parsing, storing 1.5/-0.2 unclamped, and firing the p3-linear-oog-roundtrip assert.

openQuestions.title: Show what actually paints for out-of-gamut values
openQuestions.detail: The page reads back stored values but does not show what the compositor paints for an out-of-gamut color (Chrome currently clips at paint time; css-color-4 §13 describes gamut mapping). Once the space is supported in the test browser, an additive panel comparing the stored value against a canvas-sampled painted pixel would make the stored-vs-rendered distinction concrete.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce out-of-range state on slider values live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Reflect validity/range state in text near the control and announce derived results via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Value labels turn rose and bold when a component leaves [0,1]; the gamut chips and the declaration readout are aria-live; the round-trip verdict is a live output naming exactly what the browser stored.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP: overbright preset produced flags 'P3 gamut: OUTSIDE / sRGB gamut: OUTSIDE' and a verdict quoting the stored display-p3 value.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide results table on narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Only tables may exceed the viewport, each inside its own overflow-x auto container; the page body must never scroll horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The four-column round-trip table is wrapped in .scroller; everything else stacks.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP overflow check at 360×740 DPR3: scrollWidth 360 == clientWidth 360.

guidanceConsulted.query: probe exact declaration parse and computed value
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: A support claim must come from the exact surface: attempt the real declaration and read the computed value back rather than inferring.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each row sets the literal color() string on a probe element, reports parsed/dropped from the inline-style result, and compares each slider component numerically against the serialized computed value.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: 141 evidence: display-p3 rows parsed and preserved -0.0146 and 1.5; display-p3-linear rows reported 'no — dropped (unsupported here)'.

summary: Edge/failure concept: the unclamped out-of-range contract, run as a real parse + round-trip in both the new space and the shipped display-p3 control — so the contract is demonstrable for real even on pre-144 browsers, and the new space's absence is reported, never papered over. CDP-verified on Chromium 141, both viewports, clean console.
